name: Palmetto Welding & Fabrication Services, LLC
old_description: Needed a pin and weld and was greeted with the best customer service, Amanda is amazing, and Michael is very knowledgeable. I highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for welding services. Among the rest ! ! !
about:
Palmetto Welding & Fabrication Services, LLC was founded in February 2019 by Amanda Koch and Michael Meyer in Summerville, South Carolina. The husband-and-wife team relocated from Wyoming and Texas in 2018, bringing Michael’s extensive welding background and Amanda’s administrative experience to launch a mobile welding operation that quickly grew into a full-service fabrication and erection company.

The shop specializes in structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication and erection, working with carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum. Capabilities include SMAW, GMAW, FCAW, and GTAW welding in all positions, a plasma burn table that cuts plate up to one inch thick, and production of items such as ladders, handrails, stairs, RTU frames, bollards, and canopies. In January 2020 the company moved into a 9,500-square-foot facility on two acres and employs 17 skilled workers, with plans to expand into a 30,000-square-foot building in early 2022.

Palmetto serves industries including oil and gas, marine, nuclear, automotive, and structural steel construction across the Southeast region. The company’s AISC certification for both fabrication and erection allows it to bid on projects with stringent quality requirements, and its licensed and insured status supports work for commercial and industrial clients.

The business was started after Michael identified a local need for skilled, affordable welding services for both production and mobile work. The founders emphasize adapting to client needs, with Michael’s certifications across all metals and positions and Amanda’s operational management forming the core of their competitive position.
